entries.87d0bd22971000f4: This is a single-segment business that manufactures and sells semiconductor and other electronic component manufacturing equipment. It manufactures and sells ＣＶＤ equipment that forms thin films, etching equipment that microfabricates thin films, cleaning equipment that cleans substrate surfaces, and other equipment, and provides parts and maintenance services. Manufacturing is outsourced to cooperating companies based on the company's own design planning; before shipment, the company inputs its own proprietary program software, and after specification and shipment inspections, the products are sold. Revenue for the fiscal year ended July 2026 was ¥10,800 million.
